name: Default
shortDescription: AI assistant that answers questions from your documents and the web, with PostgreSQL and pgvector, a SearXNG search engine and a Python code sandbox.

alerts.message: Sign-in uses one-time email login links. To send them by email, set RESEND_API_KEY and RESEND_EMAIL (an address on a domain verified in Resend). Without a key no email is sent: enter KHOJ_ADMIN_EMAIL on the login page, then copy the link from the khoj service logs or from the Get email login URL action on the users list in /server/admin.

No chat model is configured out of the box. Sign in to /server/admin with KHOJ_ADMIN_EMAIL and KHOJ_ADMIN_PASSWORD and add an AI Model API (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint) plus a chat model.
